timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Oxygen 2 L/min nasal cannula for comfort

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 86-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.81, creatinine 1.99, hemoglobin 14.6, platelets 212, sodium 139, wbc 7.2; vitals dbp 70-73, heart_rate 85-89, map 86-89, o2_flow 0-2, resp_rate 18-21, sbp 117-122, spo2 93-96, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Oxygen 2 L/min nasal cannula for comfort
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Not in respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.98, hemoglobin 14.5, platelets 220, sodium 139, wbc 7.5; vitals dbp 68-72, heart_rate 85-89, map 85-89, o2_flow 0-2, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 116-123, spo2 94-96, temp 37-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Not in respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 86-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Not in respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
